title: Orbital Shift - one button game inspired by Vampire Survivors (but completely different) - Claude Opus 4.8+ Gemini 3.1 Pro
author: PUBGM_MightyFine
selftext: It's currently 3,424 lines of code and around 100 hours of development across 3 weeks.

comments.author: PUBGM_MightyFine
comments.body:
[Orbital-Shift.com](https://orbital-shift.com) feedback needed!
 
It can be played on PC/Mac or Tablet/Phone

This is fully functional but I'm making significant changes and upgrades.

Try to find the most over powered combinations of weapons and upgrades in the shop. 

Try to beat my high score of 1.2 Billion and post your score with feedback. There's also a lot of visual themes and music to unlock
